findings.detail: The extracted percent-of-net-assets value appears to be taken from the Reference Rate and Spread column instead of the final Percentage of Net Assets column.

rationale: This is a Class 2 within-row defect. The filing row has separate columns for Reference Rate and Spread and Percentage of Net Assets; for DemandTec revolving loan the source shows a 5.00% spread but a 0.02% net-assets percentage. Using the filing net assets anchor of 2,384,890, fair value 358 implies approximately 0.02%, so the source net-assets percentage is internally consistent while the flagged identity residual is explained by extracting the earlier spread-like percent as pct_of_net_assets. The same structure appears on another flagged Answer Acquisition term-loan row, where 6.00% is the spread and 0.04% is the actual percent of net assets.
